scope: Frozen 1.3.7 model and engine. Supplementary analyses only; no deployment parameter changes; no test labels used for fitting or variant selection.

protocol.fitting_boundary: Existing frozen A calibrators and reliabilities reused. Variant conflict cuts only from A; variant CP only from B. Test labels used only to score outputs. No variant selected for deployment.
protocol.limitations: Single retained same-source holdout; highly concentrated attacks. Exploratory post-review analyses, not preregistered external validation. Blocks are reused for paired bootstrap, not new data.

legacy_record.legacy_ecod_field_means: max(raw test AUC,1-raw test AUC); not frozen PAIC output

matched_budget_queue.target: All methods use frozen RF errors, not their own decision errors. Exactly k reviewed rows per method. No human correction or timing assumed.

paired_block_bootstrap.caveats: Only 11 time blocks; intervals describe this heldout sample and may be unstable. Matched-queue capture interval resamples FIXED originally selected k-row sets; the resampled selected count varies with cluster replication, not a new top-k scheduling trial. Degenerate one-class replicates are omitted for AUC only. The zero unreviewed-error interval is degenerate because this sample has zero such errors; it is NOT a bound on future risk.

va_exact_comparison.scope: Exact sklearn isotonic refits after appending each score with labels 0 and 1; same B, no test labels used. Exhaustive on distinct heldout scores plus grid midpoints; not a uniform bound over all real inputs.
va_exact_comparison.interpretation: Numerical approximation diagnostic only; endpoints are Venn-Abers multiprobabilities, not per-record frequentist confidence bounds. Midpoint ECE/Brier do not test the multiprobability guarantee.

sensitivity.policy: Small prespecified perturbations; existing isotonic calibrators frozen; each altered score is calibrated for CP on B and conflict cut on A. No best setting chosen or deployed.

performance.scope: Warm in-memory dataframe -> input cleaning/base RF+LR inference -> engine appended columns; excludes CSV disk read, engine/model load, application startup, browser/UI, SQLite, export and network. Single local machine, no concurrency/load/human-speed claim. BLAS/OpenMP limited to 1 thread; estimator own n_jobs unchanged.
